SUNIL RATHOR

Contact: 8530493700 | Email: sunilrathor2703@gmail.com

Profile Summary

Senior Business Analyst with 14+ years of experience in Global Banking and Financial Services, including 8+ years in Business Analysis across Corporate Actions, Reconciliation, Transaction Lifecycle Management, and Client Servicing. Experienced in Business Process Transformation, Target Operating Model (TOM), AS-IS/TO-BE Process Mapping, Business Capability Mapping, Process Architecture, Customer Journey Mapping, Stakeholder Management, Agile delivery, and end-to-end business transformation initiatives. Proven expertise in translating business requirements into scalable operating models, automation-driven solutions, and future-state business processes that improve operational efficiency and strengthen governance.

Core Competencies

Business Requirements Gathering (BRD, FRD, FSD), User Stories, Use Cases & Acceptance Criteria • Gap Analysis & Impact Analysis • Business Process Modeling (BPMN) & Process Re-engineering • Stakeholder Management & Requirement Traceability (RTM) • Agile / Scrum Methodology • Sprint Planning, Backlog Grooming & Retrospectives • Product Lifecycle Support • User Acceptance Testing (UAT) Coordination, Change & Release Management TOM (Target Operating Model)

Jira, API integration, REST, SOAP, • Confluence, AI • Microsoft SQL Server, AWS • Microsoft Excel, Power Bi • Wireframing & Process Mapping Tools • SQL Querying & Data Analysis • API Integration & API Documentation • Data Validation & Reporting (Excel / SQL) • System Integration & Functional Testing

Professional Experience

BNY MELLON Senior Business Analyst | Apr 2018 – July 2026

Associate – Operation and Business Analysis | Sep 2012 – Mar 2018

Project: Global Corporate Actions Processing Platform (GCAPP)





•





Led end-to-end business analysis for the Portfolio Service System (PSS), supporting global corporate actions processing across multiple markets and asset classes Collaborate with operations, product owners, and technology teams to gather, analyze, and document business requirements (BRD, FRD, user stories) Conduct AS-IS and TO-BE process analysis to identify gaps, inefficiencies, and automation opportunities Facilitate stakeholder workshops to define requirements for mandatory and voluntary corporate actions, including client election workflows Contributed to defining the Target Operating Model (TOM) by documenting future-state operating processes, governance controls, business rules, and stakeholder responsibilities for global corporate actions processing. Facilitated business workshops to validate future-state operating models, ensuring alignment between Operations, Product Owners, Technology, and Business stakeholders. Performed Business Capability Assessment to identify process gaps, capability improvements, and automation opportunities across the corporate actions lifecycle.

Developed Process Architecture documentation, including end-to-end process flows, business workflows, and operational control

models to support enterprise transformation initiatives. Translate complex business needs into functional specifications aligned with mainframe system capabilities Perform data mapping and reconciliation analysis for entitlements, payments, and exception handling

• • Define test strategies, test cases, and UAT scenarios in collaboration with QA teams • • Act as a liaison between business and technology teams to ensure timely and accurate solution delivery • Led User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including defect triage, tracking, and business sign-off

•

Support change management, impact analysis, and release coordination activities

Project: Enterprise Reconciliation & Transaction Lifecycle Platform (ERTLP)







Lead end-to-end business analysis for the TLM platform, supporting reconciliation of cash and securities across internal systems and external counterparties. Collaborate with operations, custody, and technology stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document business requirements (BRD, FRD, user stories) Conducted Business Capability Mapping to identify functional ownership, upstream/downstream process dependencies, and opportunities for standardization across reconciliation platforms. Supported Operating Model Transformation initiatives by redesigning reconciliation workflows, improving governance, and enhancing operational controls across trade, cash, and securities reconciliation.

Developed end-to-end Process Architecture and workflow models using BPMN/UML to support reconciliation modernization and

strategic transformation initiatives. Collaborated with Product, Operations, Technology, and Business stakeholders to define future-state reconciliation capabilities and business operating procedures. Performed Impact Assessments and transformation planning for new reconciliation capabilities, ensuring alignment with business objectives and technology roadmaps. • Conduct AS-IS and TO-BE process analysis to identify inefficiencies and define optimized reconciliation workflows • Define and document matching rules, break categories, and exception handling workflows for reconciliation processes •





Facilitate stakeholder workshops to align on requirements for internal and external reconciliation, including custodians and brokers • Perform data mapping and data normalization analysis across trade, cash, and position data from multiple source systems • Work closely with development teams to define API specifications for data ingestion, matching engine execution, and reporting

services Support design and implementation of real-time and batch reconciliation processes & Develop functional specifications, data dictionaries, and process flow diagrams (UML, workflow diagrams) Partner with QA teams to define test strategies, test cases, and reconciliation validation scenarios Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including defect management, resolution tracking, and business sign-off



• • Monitor reconciliation breaks, perform root cause analysis (RCA), and recommend rule tuning and process improvements • Support dashboard and reporting requirements, including KPIs, ageing analysis, match rate, and exception summaries • Ensure adherence to risk and control frameworks, including audit trails, maker-checker controls, and SLA tracking • Act as a liaison between business and technology teams to ensure timely delivery and alignment with business objectives

Project Name: Enterprise Client Service & Case Management Platform (ECSMP)

Lead business analysis to transform email-based client servicing into a centralized, SLA-driven case management system. • Gather and document requirements (BRD, FRD, user stories) and define end-to-end case lifecycle workflows including intake,



assignment, escalation, and closure Collaborate with stakeholders and technology teams to design APIs, data models, dashboards, and reporting for real-time tracking and performance monitoring

Drive UAT, ensure audit compliance, and deliver process improvements to enhance SLA adherence, transparency, and operational

efficiency

Designed end-to-end Client Journey Maps covering case intake, assignment, escalation, resolution, and closure to improve





customer experience and operational efficiency. Supported the definition of the Target Operating Model (TOM) for centralized case management by standardizing workflows, governance, SLA management, and ownership across business functions. Conducted Customer Journey Mapping workshops with business stakeholders to identify pain points, optimize service delivery, and improve operational transparency.

Defined future-state business processes and operating procedures supporting enterprise-wide client servicing transformation.

Project Name: Operational Automation & Controls Platform (Baseline)



Lead business analysis to identify and automate high-risk operational processes, including corporate action payments on loaned securities at BNY Mellon

Gather and document requirements (BRD, FRD, user stories) and define workflows for tax withholding, Section 302 processing,





•

and automation use cases Collaborate with stakeholders and technology teams to implement automation solutions, reducing manual effort, improving processing efficiency, and strengthening operational controls Supported Business Process Transformation initiatives by identifying automation opportunities, improving operational controls, and strengthening governance frameworks. Performed Business Capability Assessment and Gap Analysis to prioritize automation initiatives and enhance operational resilience.

•

Collaborated with business and technology teams to translate strategic business objectives into scalable functional solutions supporting future-state operating models.

Business Analyst Eclerx Services Limited | Nov 2011 – Aug 2012 Project: Derivatives Documentation & Reconciliation Optimization



Performed detailed validation and reconciliation of derivative documentation by verifying economic parameters and matching system data, ensuring accuracy and timely discrepancy resolution.

Generated and analyzed monthly business reports on valuation statements and query trends, enabling improved tracking,

transparency, and decision-making.

Managed high-volume operations with strong SLA adherence, minimizing errors and enhancing overall process efficiency and

data quality.

Education & Certifications

Postgraduate in Management Program (PGMP) (Finance) | Viva Institute Of Management Studies (VIMS) | 2011 • Bachelor of Science |Bhadrak Autonomous College | 2009 • Business Analysis & API Mastery Certification from MAD4API Technologies | Mar 2024

Key Achievements

Drove automation and process optimization initiatives across corporate actions and reconciliation platforms, reducing manual intervention by ~20% and improving overall operational efficiency • Enhanced reconciliation accuracy and match rates by optimizing matching rules and data mapping in TLM, resulting in ~18% increase in auto-match rates and ~20% reduction in exceptions • Led successful implementation of SLA-driven case management system, improving turnaround time by ~25% and increasing SLA adherence by ~30%, significantly enhancing client servicing and transparency
